title: EdgeLight-GAN: code for an edge aware lightweight multiresolution generative adversarial network for low light image enhancement on resource constrained devices
description: PyTorch implementation of EdgeLight-GAN, a lightweight multi-resolution GAN for low-light image enhancement: model definitions, training and evaluation scripts, dataset loaders, losses, and profiling utilities (parameters, FLOPs, latency, memory). Code companion to the manuscript submitted to Scientific Reports.
